commands.name: check-deploy-status
commands.title: Forge Deployments
commands.description: Shows sites that are currently being deployed

ai.instructions:
Deployments belong to sites, not servers.
Deploy failed? Call deployment-status, then deployment-log.
Site down or erroring? Call site-online, then site-config.
Server problem? Call server-events.
Pass ids as text: "2882133", not 2882133.
Only deploy, restart or reboot if the user asks.
Env file or deploy settings? get-site answers with a Forge link. site-config cannot read them.
List rows are short. Call probe-api for the field names, then pass the ones you need to list-sites or list-servers in fields.
A tool may return a Forge link. Give it to the user as a markdown link. Do not open it yourself.

evals.input: @laravel-forge does acme-store have zero downtime deploys?

list-sites.note: One Forge page of 3 sites. Forge reports no total.

get-site.name: acme-store.com
get-site.environment: Not returned. The user can read or edit it at https://forge.laravel.com/acme-org/web-1/5001/environment
get-site.deploymentScript: Not returned. The user can read or edit it at https://forge.laravel.com/acme-org/web-1/5001/settings/deployments
get-site.deploymentUrl: Not returned. The user can find or change it at https://forge.laravel.com/acme-org/web-1/5001/settings/deployments

fields.status: How far the install got, like installed or installing.
fields.php_version: The PHP version the site runs, formatted like PHP 8.3.
fields.zero_downtime_deployments: Whether deploys swap in an atomic release.
fields.deployment_script: The commands Forge runs on each deploy. You cannot read this. The get tool gives a Forge link instead.
fields.environment: The site's env file. Forge keeps it on a separate endpoint. You cannot read this. The get tool gives a Forge link instead.

probe-api.note: These are field names, not values. Pass the ones you want to list-sites in fields. get-site returns every site field it can.

fields.local_public_key: The server's own SSH public key. A git host uses it as a deploy key. Ask for it by name in include.

tools.name: list-servers
tools.title: List Servers
tools.description: List your Forge servers. Filter by region, provider, PHP, database, Ubuntu, size or IP. Returns one page of short rows.

tools.name: list-sites
tools.title: List Sites
tools.description: List or search your Forge sites. Returns one page of short rows.

tools.name: get-server
tools.title: Get a Server
tools.description: Get one server's details and its sites.

tools.name: deployment-status
tools.title: Check Deployment Status
tools.description: Which sites are deploying now and which have a failed deploy.

tools.name: deployment-history
tools.title: Get Deployment History
tools.description: Recent deployments of a site, with status, commit and timings.

tools.name: deployment-log
tools.title: Read Deployment Log
tools.description: Output of a site's latest deploy, or of one deploy by id.

tools.name: server-events
tools.title: Get Server Events
tools.description: Recent events on a server, or the output of one event.

tools.name: site-online
tools.title: Check If a Site Is Online
tools.description: Whether a site answers over HTTP.

tools.name: site-config
tools.title: Read Site Config or Logs
tools.description: Read a site's nginx config, application log, nginx error log or access log.

tools.name: deploy-site
tools.title: Deploy a Site
tools.description: Deploy a site's latest commit. Pass the id from list-sites.

tools.name: restart-service
tools.title: Restart a Service
tools.description: Restart, reload or stop php, nginx, the database or redis on a server. Pass the id from list-servers.

tools.name: reboot-server
tools.title: Reboot a Server
tools.description: Reboot a server. Every site on it goes down until it returns. Pass the id from list-servers.

tools.name: probe-api
tools.title: Probe the Forge API
tools.description: List every field name a site or server has, and what Forge can filter and sort on.
